business_problem: Devon Energy needed faster access to operational data and a scalable way to calculate bottomhole pressure across thousands of wells without manual work, custom APIs, or expensive physical sensors.
solution_summary: Devon Energy built a Data Hub on Snowflake to combine more than 30 operational and business sources into one warehouse-and-lake foundation for engineers, analysts, and vendor collaboration. Data from systems including SAP ERP and well operations is centralized in Snowflake, where teams can query a broader share of enterprise data and make rig, reservoir, and site-selection decisions faster. For the bottomhole-pressure use case, Devon uses Snowflake Secure Data Sharing to send time-series and wellbore configuration data directly to Whitson's whitson+ physics engine, which calculates bottomhole pressure and returns results through the same sharing model. Those calculations are then consumed in whitson+ and Devon's SCADA environment so reservoir and production engineers can monitor well health daily without manual calculations or $50,000 sensors in each well. The architecture turns Snowflake into both the governed data backbone and the bidirectional collaboration layer for SaaS partners.
